nodes.label: View model (list / detail / compare)
nodes.rationale: renderView empties hidden views so their elements don't shadow the active view's; canvases are looked up inside the view element.

nodes.label: delete_expired_requests() SQL function
nodes.rationale: Pending registrations auto-delete after 24h via pg_cron.

nodes.label: Pure-JS binary FIT parser (msg 20 Record, msg 19 Lap)
nodes.norm_label: pure-js binary fit parser (msg 20 record, msg 19 lap)
nodes.rationale: Elevation from field 78 enhanced_altitude; no external library.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Pages deployment
nodes.rationale: Empty build command, output directory '/'; every push to main deploys live.

nodes.label: IndexedDB ridecomp_v1 store
nodes.rationale: Legacy RideComp naming kept so existing users' data still loads.

nodes.label: Stored ride record schema
nodes.rationale: {id, name, color, points, stats, fileType, laps, savedAt}; new fields must be added to toRecord, hydrate and the Supabase sync payload.

nodes.label: RLS policy 'Users delete own rides'
nodes.rationale: Without a delete policy Supabase silently deletes nothing; deleteRides uses .select('id') to detect this and re-hydrates kept rides.

nodes.label: Free key-less basemaps (OSM, OpenTopoMap, Esri, Dark)
nodes.norm_label: free key-less basemaps (osm, opentopomap, esri, dark)

nodes.label: Supabase OAuth redirect URL configuration
nodes.rationale: Site URL and Redirect URLs must include the Pages URL or OAuth sign-in fails; authWith passes redirectTo origin+pathname.

nodes.label: Inline onclick handlers call globals
nodes.rationale: Markup in index.html and JS-built HTML strings calls global functions by name, so renaming a function breaks the markup.

nodes.label: Hard-coded SUPABASE connection
nodes.rationale: The site is private; hard-coding the URL and publishable key prevents pointing it at another project. Must not be made configurable again.

nodes.label: Zero-build plain browser scripts (shared global scope)
nodes.norm_label: zero-build plain browser scripts (shared global scope)
nodes.rationale: No build step, no modules, no node_modules; all scripts share one global scope and deploy as static files.

nodes.label: No CARTO tiles
nodes.rationale: basemaps.cartocdn.com now returns an 'API KEY REQUIRED' placeholder with HTTP 200 for every tile.

nodes.label: Responsive glass sidebar / mobile bottom sheet
nodes.norm_label: responsive glass sidebar / mobile bottom sheet

nodes.label: STATS_VER stats recompute versioning
nodes.rationale: Stats recompute when stats.v !== STATS_VER, so bump it after changing computeStats.

nodes.label: Ride fingerprint duplicate protection
nodes.rationale: t:<start epoch> or endpoints+distance for untimed routes; same ride renamed or as GPX vs FIT gets the same fingerprint. App JS and SQL backfill must agree.

nodes.label: Unique index (user_id, fingerprint)
nodes.rationale: Database rejects duplicates; sync treats error 23505 as already in the cloud.

nodes.label: Optional MapTiler/Mapbox keys with free-tile fallback
nodes.norm_label: optional maptiler/mapbox keys with free-tile fallback
nodes.rationale: Bad keys return 401/403 with a placeholder image so tileerror never fires; checkTileKey probes one tile with fetch().
